props.name: alwaysOn
props.comment:
As a `<FilterForm>`/`<FilterButton>` filter: always shown, never in the
add-filter menu. Read off the element by the filter layer, never by the input.

props.name: defaultValue
props.comment:
Input-level default, ra precedence (seeds only into an untouched hole).
Typed as the value at `source`; `unknown` without a record.

props.name: disabled
props.comment: Native disabled state.

props.name: helperText
props.comment: Helper text rendered below the input; a string is translated.

props.name: id
props.comment: Explicit element id; a generated `useId` value is used otherwise.

props.name: isRequired
props.comment: Forces the required marker; ORed with `required()` detection on `validate`.

props.name: label
props.comment:
The input label. A string is translated; a ReactNode renders as-is;
`false` (or `""`) renders no label.

props.name: name
props.comment: Legacy field-name alias (ra parity); the wiring uses `source`.

props.name: onBlur
props.comment: Chained AFTER the blur is recorded.

props.name: onChange
props.comment: Chained AFTER the parsed value is written to the form.

props.name: parse
props.comment:
Write transform (input value → stored value). Must return the value at
`source`; `unknown` without a record.

props.name: readOnly
props.comment: Native read-only state.

props.name: resource
props.comment: Override the ambient resource (used to resolve the default label key).

props.name: type
props.comment: The DOM input `type` (text inputs default to `"text"`).

props.name: validate
props.comment: ra-contract validators — composed, first error wins.

props.name: source
props.comment: The field path RELATIVE to the ambient source scope.

props.name: clearOnBlur
props.comment: When true, clear the filter text on input blur.

props.name: emptyText
props.comment: Accepted for API parity; not rendered in the array variant.

props.name: handleHomeEndKeys
props.comment: When true, Home/End keys scroll the listbox to first/last item.

props.name: inputText
props.comment: Custom display text for badge labels.

props.name: isOptionEqualToValue
props.comment: Custom equality check between a choice value and a selected value.

props.name: limitChoicesToValue
props.comment: When true, only show already-selected choices in the dropdown.

props.name: matchSuggestion
props.comment: Custom filter function; replaces default substring match.

props.name: modal
props.comment: Radix popover modality.

props.name: noOptionsText
props.comment: Content to show when no choices match the filter.

props.name: openOnFocus
props.comment: When true, open the dropdown on input focus (default for the array variant).

props.name: selectOnFocus
props.comment: When true, select all text in the input on focus.

props.name: setFilter
props.comment: Called with the current filter text on every keystroke (no debounce).

props.name: shouldRenderSuggestions
props.comment: Gate controlling whether the dropdown opens at all.

props.name: suggestionLimit
props.comment: Cap the number of dropdown items shown.
